name: Patellar Tendon Rupture
definition: Disruption of the patellar tendon causing loss of active knee extension, often after sudden eccentric load or in patients with systemic/tendon risk factors.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is often clinical plus radiographs.
investigations.MRI: Ultrasound/MRI confirms uncertain tears and surgical anatomy.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs may show patella alta and associated fracture.

amber: Complete rupture usually requires surgical repair.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu-Snayu rupture phenotype may be documented; modern extensor-mechanism repair remains primary.

patientEducation.summary: Disruption of the patellar tendon causing loss of active knee extension, often after sudden eccentric load or in patients with systemic/tendon risk factors.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
